title: Story 12: Idea Discarded — Product Idea Rejected by Product Owner
pmResponse:
# Action Plan: Ideas Loop — Product Idea Discarded

## Scenario Analysis

- **Issue #90** "Replace agentrack with Jira integration" is an `idea` from `library-developer`, unassigned.
- No duplicates found across all statuses.
- The idea proposes replacing the product itself — this is a **product direction** decision → route to `product-owner`.
- The product-owner will ultimately **reject** the idea, so I follow the **Discarded** path.

---

## Step 1: Verify No Duplicates (Already Confirmed)

```bash
agt list --tags idea
```

```bash
agt list --status closed --tags idea
```

**Reasoning:** The skill mandates a duplicate check across ALL statuses (`idea`, `todo`, `in-progress`, `closed`) with the `idea` tag matching topic keywords. The scenario confirms no matches for "Jira" or "integration", so I proceed to routing.

---

## Step 2: Create the Review Task for the Product Owner

```bash
agt create "Review idea: Replace agentrack with Jira integration" --tags task --assignee product-owner --status todo --parentId 90
```

**Result:** This creates issue **#91** (the Review task).

**Reasoning:** The idea is a product-direction question ("replace the product itself"), so it routes to the `product-owner`. The Review task is tagged `task` (the standard tag for routed review work), assigned to the `product-owner`, created as a child of idea #90, and left at `todo` so the work loop picks it up and hands it to the product-owner.

---

## Step 3: Create the Sync Tracker (Blocked by the Review Task)

```bash
agt create "Check review decision for Jira integration idea" --tags task,sync --assignee project-manager --status todo --parentId 90
```

**Result:** This creates issue **#92** (the sync tracker).

```bash
agt blockages add 92 --by 91
```

**Reasoning:** The sync tracker (tag `task,sync` — both words, never just `sync`) is assigned to `project-manager` and left at `todo`. It is blocked by the Review task (#91) so the work loop won't wake me until the product-owner completes their review. When the product-owner marks #91 `done`, the blockage auto-clears → the sync tracker becomes unblocked → the loop hands it to me → I read the decision and act.

---

## Step 4: Set the Idea to `in-progress` to Prevent Re-triggering

```bash
agt update 90 --status in-progress --assignee project-manager
```

**Reasoning:** The skill explicitly requires setting the idea itself to `in-progress`, assigned to `project-manager`. This prevents the work loop from re-waking me on the same idea issue while the review is in progress.

---

## Issue Hierarchy at This Point

```
#90  "Replace agentrack with Jira integration"
     tag: idea → (will change later)
     status: in-progress
     assignee: project-manager
 ├── #91  "Review idea: Replace agentrack with Jira integration"
 │        tag: task
 │        status: todo → (product-owner drives: todo → in-progress → done)
 │        assignee: product-owner
 ├── #92  "Check review decision for Jira integration idea"  [SYNC TRACKER]
 │        tag: task,sync
 │        status: todo
 │        assignee: project-manager
 │        BLOCKED BY: #91
```

---

## Step 5: Product Owner Reviews and Rejects (Worker-Driven)

The product-owner picks up #91 from the work loop, sets it to `in-progress`, adds a comment with their decision (reject — the idea contradicts the product's purpose; replacing agentrack with Jira defeats the tool's existence), and marks #91 `done`.

**This auto-clears the blockage on #92.** I do NOT run `agt blockages resolve` — the system handles it.

---

## Step 6: Sync Tracker Wakes Me — I Act on the Rejection

The sync tracker (#92) is now unblocked → the work loop hands it to me. I read the product-owner's comment on #91 (the rejection), and follow the **Discarded** path.

### 6a: Mark the Sync Tracker Done

```bash
agt update 92 --status done
```

```bash
agt comments add 92 --content "Product owner reviewed and rejected the idea. Sync tracker complete — proceeding to close idea #90 as discarded."
```

**Reasoning:** I've read the decision via the sync tracker; my job as the alarm clock is done. I mark it `done` and document.

### 6b: Close the Idea with Discarded Tags

```bash
agt update 90 --tags idea,discarded --status closed
```

```bash
agt comments add 90 --content "Idea discarded. The product-owner reviewed this proposal and rejected it — replacing agentrack with a Jira integration contradicts the product's core purpose (agentrack IS the issue tracking system for this organization). No implementation will be pursued. Originator: library-developer. Reviewer: product-owner. Decision: Discarded."
```

**Reasoning:** The skill's Discarded path: "mark sync tracker `done`; close with `idea,discarded` tags + comment." I retag the idea to `idea,discarded` (preserving the `idea` tag for audit trail and adding `discarded`), set status to `closed`, and add a thorough comment documenting the full lifecycle — originator, reviewer, decision, and reasoning.

---

## Final Issue Hierarchy

```
#90  "Replace agentrack with Jira integration"
     tag: idea,discarded
     status: closed
     assignee: project-manager
 ├── #91  "Review idea: Replace agentrack with Jira integration"
 │        tag: task
 │        status: done
 │        assignee: product-owner
 ├── #92  "Check review decision for Jira integration idea"  [SYNC TRACKER]
 │        tag: task,sync
 │        status: done
 │        assignee: project-manager
 │        (was BLOCKED BY #91 — auto-cleared when #91 marked done)
```

---

## Complete Command Sequence (in execution order)

| # | Command | Purpose |
|---|---------|---------|
| 1 | `agt list --tags idea` | Duplicate check (idea/to/in-progress statuses) |
| 2 | `agt list --status closed --tags idea` | Duplicate check (closed statuses) |
| 3 | `agt create "Review idea: Replace agentrack with Jira integration" --tags task --assignee product-owner --status todo --parentId 90` | Create Review task for product-owner (#91) |
| 4 | `agt create "Check review decision for Jira integration idea" --tags task,sync --assignee project-manager --status todo --parentId 90` | Create sync tracker (#92) |
| 5 | `agt blockages add 92 --by 91` | Block sync tracker by Review task |
| 6 | `agt update 90 --status in-progress --assignee project-manager` | Prevent work loop from re-triggering on the idea |
| — | *(wait: product-owner completes #91 → auto-clears blockage on #92 → sync tracker wakes me)* | — |
| 7 | `agt update 92 --status done` | Mark sync tracker complete |
| 8 | `agt comments add 92 --content "Product owner reviewed and rejected the idea. Sync tracker complete — proceeding to close idea #90 as discarded."` | Document sync tracker closure |
| 9 | `agt update 90 --tags idea,discarded --status closed` | Close the idea as discarded |
| 10 | `agt comments add 90 --content "Idea discarded. The product-owner reviewed this proposal and rejected it — replacing agentrack with a Jira integration contradicts the product's core purpose (agentrack IS the issue tracking system for this organization). No implementation will be pursued. Originator: library-developer. Reviewer: product-owner. Decision: Discarded."` | Document final decision with full audit trail |

---

## Key Rule Compliance Checklist

- ✅ **Duplicate check** across all statuses before routing
- ✅ **Routed to `product-owner`** (product idea, not a technical lead)
- ✅ **Review task** tagged `task`, assigned to routed manager
- ✅ **Sync tracker** tagged `task,sync` (both words), assigned to `project-manager`, blocked by Review
- ✅ **Idea set to `in-progress`** assigned to `project-manager` to prevent re-triggering
- ✅ **Did NOT evaluate the idea myself** — routed, didn't decide
- ✅ **Discarded path**: sync tracker `done` → idea retagged `idea,discarded` → status `closed` → comment with full audit trail
- ✅ **No manual `blockages resolve`** in the work loop — auto-clear handled it when #91 went `done`
- ✅ **No implementation children created** — discarded ideas get no deliverables
feedback: Excellent response. Correctly routes the product idea to product-owner without evaluating it itself, creates the review task (#91) and sync tracker (#92) with proper task/task,sync tags, correct assignees, and the sync tracker properly blocked by the review task. Parent idea set to in-progress to prevent re-triggering. Discarded path followed correctly: sync tracker marked done, idea retagged idea,discarded and closed with audit-trail comment, no implementation children created. Minor gaps: the initial routing comment to #90 (\"Routed to product-owner for product decision...\") was omitted, and the product-owner comment suggestion about Jira export as an alternative feature was not incorporated into the closing comment."}
